text: Anyone have a good lunch spot rec near the office? I’m tired of the same old sandwiches from Deli Depot.
Try Tacos El Camino on 17th! Their carnitas are 🔥. Also, did anyone catch the Nuggets game last night? That 3rd quarter was wild.
Seconding Tacos El Camino. Also, has anyone seen the warehouse cat today? I swear she was sleeping on top of the label printer again 😂
Warehouse cat is a legend. She knocked over my coffee this morning but looked so proud of herself lol. And yes, Nuggets game was insane!
Haha, I need to meet this cat. Thanks for the lunch tips! Maybe we should do a team lunch at El Camino next week?
